newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill two policemen in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill two policemen in Karachi.

text.p: Gunmen killed two policemen and wounded a passerby in a drive-by shooting in the southern Pakistani city of Karachi on Saturday, police said.

They said the attack took place in the Gulbahar area of the volatile District Central, a stronghold of the ethnic Mohajir National Movement (MQM) group, involved in a longstanding conflict with the security forces.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility from the MQM or any of Karachi's other armed groups.
The MQM speaks for Urdu-speaking people who migrated from India at Partition in 1947 and their descendants. The government blames the group for most of the violence in Karachi.
The MQM says scores of its members have been victims of summary killings by state security forces.
More than 370 people have been killed in political and sectarian violence in Karachi this year, down from the estimated 2,000 who died during 1995.
